notes.title: WASD Fix + New Skills
notes.content:
- Now we can press A/D and W/S at the same time (move diagonally), so hopefully the movement on the desktop version isn't that rigid anymore.
- Added one more tip: The enemies' spawn points aren't random, so you can make a tactic.

March 30:
- New skills: Extra Shot, Saintly Beam, and I Am Hurt.
- Bug fixes (skill and achievement bug).

notes.title: Dev Plan + Bombs Are Now Limited!
notes.content:
[b]Bombs Are Now Limited![/b]
To prevent bomb spams and the disaster because of the Demon class' playstyle, now the amount of bombs we can shoot is limited.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911648/a2c55ae2e4cabc723a2693eea53a4fbf0e620e26.png[/img]
The maximum number of bombs we can load is 6 by default (Challenger difficulty). We can see the number of bombs under the MP. Each time we hit an enemy with a correct bomb, we get one more bomb. We can also use the [Reload] skill to max our bombs.

The unlimited bombs feature may be included on [Setting] in the future. Because when I tested the latest version (Challenger difficulty), the last boss was damn hard when the bombs are limited. I think too easy is boring, but too hard is frustrating.

[b]Other Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] The Lucky Encounter now gives 500 coins.
[*] Some skills' MP is reduced due to the bomb limitation above.
[/list]

[b]Development Plan[/b]
The planned features may be changed or canceled based on their necessities and players' feedback.

[list]
[*] Story + Grammar Notes
A story will be added. Sometimes, there will be a Hangul subtitle. When there is a subtitle, a new grammar rule will be added to the Grammar Notes. This way, we can learn Korean grammar by context.

[*] 2-Beolsik Minigame
We can practice typing Hangul with a QWERTY keyboard with this minigame. Yes, this minigame seems useless for phone users, but I think it's important for desktop users.

[*] Grammar Tutorial Package
These grammar tutorials + tests are supposed to supplement the grammar learning by Grammar Notes above, just in case Grammar Notes aren't enough. Since this is a package, this is a paid feature, so Steam in-app purchases will be added.

[*] A Male Pilot Skin
A male pilot skin will be added. Since he isn't a weeb, he speaks English. This skin is useful for the Neutral class' playstyle.

[*] Hiragana + Katakana Package
This package will unlock levels to learn Hiragana or Katakana. But this feature doesn't have a high priority to be implemented.

[*] Rally Phase
We need to avoid the enemies or use skills in the Rush Phase. But in the Rally Phase, we need to clear a path because there is a horde of slow enemies. The Rally Phase was already mentioned on [Tips] but hadn't been implemented.

[*] No Hangul Pronunciation or Stroke Tutorials
I think some great learning sources to learn Hangul pronunciation or stroke already exist: Korean VTuber/prank videos with Hangul subtitles, K-pop songs, and Korean children's songs like "The Three Bears". Therefore, features to learn Hangul pronunciation or stroke probably won't be added.
[/list]

Yeah, what a long to-do list, I don't know when I can implement all of them, haha. Anyway, have a good day, and feel free to share your thoughts about this update/dev plan. Thank you!

notes.title: March 22 Small Update
notes.content:
- Added Steam achievements.
- 3000 coins for current and new players if their coins are less than 3000.
- A few UI fixes: ''Reset" becomes "Set" on the minigames, and the Credit section is now full.
